hooks.name: Create Session Branch on Start
hooks.description: Creates a new git branch named kiro/session-<timestamp> at the start of each Kiro session

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $branch = \"kiro/session-$timestamp\"; git checkout -b $branch 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host \"Created and switched to branch: $branch\" } else { Write-Host \"Failed to create session branch\" }"
